Faster, louder, all night, around and around till the morning's first light.

Ms. Naomi spoke softly, with tissues close by. She asked what she asks everyone, eye to eye.
Do you feel safe at home?
Mommy thought of the noise, her children, the mornings, the shoes and the toys.
Inside my house, yes. Behind my front door. It's when we step outside it.

Mommy was quiet a long time. Then she told the truth.
No. I don't feel safe. I don't feel safe in my community. I don't feel like I can keep my children safe. I don't believe the people around me believe that my life is worth what their life is worth.
